parameters.explanation: Pre-cropped brand logo asset must perceptually match the registered vector/raster brand asset within a Hamming distance threshold of <= 10. Limitation: strictly evaluates isolated/pre-cropped logo assets; unsegmented full-scene creatives require prior bounding-box localization.

positive_test_cases.description: Completely different logo fails perceptual threshold (expected_match: false triggers BLOCK finding)

negative_test_cases.description: Exact canonical reference logo matches approved asset (expected_match: true)
Resized brand logo matches approved reference asset (expected_match: true)
Slightly altered brand logo within tolerance threshold matches reference asset (expected_match: true)
